definitions.explanation: hearing something incorrectly or misunderstanding what was said

examples.japanese: {聞|き}き{間違|まちが}いだったらすみません。

⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{聞|き}き{間違|まちが}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勘違|かんちが}い→勘違い：17609_kanchigai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I misheard on the phone and got the appointment time wrong.

notes:
USAGE:
Typical on the phone, in noisy places, or with similar-sounding numbers and names. {聞|き}き{間違|まちが}いだったらすみません is a polite way to check something you think you heard.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {聞|き}き⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧ - the same meaning; slightly more old-fashioned
- ⟦{聞|き}き{取|と}れない→聞き取る：04583_kikitoru⟧ - cannot catch what was said (not a mishearing, just not hearing)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{言|い}い{間違|まちが}い→言い間違い：08579_iimachigai⟧ - slip of the tongue
- ⟦{書|か}き{間違|まちが}い→書き間違い：08580_kakimachigai⟧ - writing mistake
- ⟦{読|よ}み{間違|まちが}い→読み間違い：08581_yomimachigai⟧ - misreading
- ⟦{見間違|みまちが}い→見間違い：08582_mimachigai⟧ - seeing something wrong
